what: Recovery gate uses git diff HEAD --stat as the sole working-tree evidence, which ignores untracked files
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed manifest after an implementation that only added new files still emits manifest-schema-invalid and the work remains unrecovered
suggested_fix: Use git status --porcelain, or combine git diff --stat HEAD with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard, for the non-empty working-tree gate

what: Plan names RECOVERY_PRIOR_TOOL from TOOL_LABEL, but the dispatcher defines TOOL_TAG, not TOOL_LABEL
scenario_or_breakage: Under set -u, the recovery branch can abort on an unbound variable instead of emitting the recovery envelope
suggested_fix: Emit RECOVERY_PRIOR_TOOL from $TOOL_TAG or define a dispatcher-local TOOL_LABEL before the recovery helper

what: Recovery exits before the existing branch, protected-path, submodule, and Cursor HEAD-unchanged validations
scenario_or_breakage: The malformed-manifest path can authorize Claude fallback for a tree where Cursor moved HEAD, .claude-plugin/plugin.json changed, or a submodule is dirty, and commit-implementation.sh does not recheck those rails
suggested_fix: Factor the post-implementer mechanical validations into a reusable guard and run them before emitting recovery, failing closed on any violation

what: Duplicating the schema template in the prompt is only protected by an edit-in-sync note and substring tests
scenario_or_breakage: Field-level drift between the canonical schema and inline template can pass tests while still teaching implementers the wrong contract
suggested_fix: Generate the inline template from the canonical schema or add a sync test that compares required keys, field names, and status-specific requirements between the schema reference and agents/_implementer-base.md
